_comment: Paste ONE of these objects into the authProfiles array of an OOG suite, then point the environment at it via environments[].authProfile. Values written as ${VAR} are read from the environment of the machine running the tool, so nothing secret is stored in the suite file.
_how_to_use: 1. Replace <CLIENT_ID> and <SCOPE> with the values the React frontend uses on the target environment (VITE_APP_CLIENT_ID and VITE_APP_SCOPE).
2. Replace <TENANT_ID> in tokenUrl if the tenant differs from the one below.
3. Set the environment's authProfile to the profile name, e.g. environments[] with name 'modern-sit' -> "authProfile": "sit-oauth-password".
4. Export the referenced variables in the CI job before running the jar.

option_A_password_grant.name: sit-oauth-password
option_A_password_grant.description: User token via ROPC. Fully unattended, but the identity provider must permit the password grant and the account must not be subject to MFA.

option_B_refresh_token_grant.name: sit-oauth-refresh
option_B_refresh_token_grant.description: User token from a stored refresh token. Requires one interactive login to obtain the refresh token, then runs unattended until the token is revoked or expires.

option_C_client_credentials.name: sit-oauth-app
option_C_client_credentials.description: Application token. Kept here for completeness only: it carries no user identity, so services that read preferred_username from the token will reject it.

_extra_params_example._note: extraParams are appended to the token request body last and override anything the tool sets, for providers that require their own parameters.
